title: A Taxonomy-Driven Synthetic Dataset for Retrieval Effectiveness and Fairness Evaluation in Hiring
abstract: arXiv:2611.09178v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While machine learning hiring tools are ubiquitous, the need for privacy regulations and commercial sensitivity makes public benchmarking legally complex. We address this challenge by introducing a taxonomy-driven, fully synthetic HR dataset and benchmark to simultaneously evaluate retrieval effectiveness and algorithmic fairness. Grounded in 660K real freelancer profiles, our multilingual corpus features candidate profiles, project briefs, and counterfactual demographic twins. Auditing state-of-the-art embedding models reveals performance divergence from general MTEB scores, alongside fairness disparities in grammatically gendered languages. This demonstrates that general benchmarks are insufficient for HR, requiring tailored evaluations to identify Pareto-optimal models that balance semantic accuracy and fairness.

translated_title: 一个基于分类学驱动的合成数据集：用于招聘场景下的检索有效性与公平性评估
translated_abstract: 尽管机器学习招聘工具已无处不在，但隐私法规和商业敏感性的要求使得公开基准测试在法律上变得复杂。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了一个基于分类学驱动的完全合成的HR数据集和基准，可同时评估检索有效性和算法公平性。该多语言语料库基于66万份真实自由职业者档案构建，包含候选人档案、项目简介以及反事实人口统计孪生体。对最先进的嵌入模型的审计显示，其性能与通用MTEB分数存在差异，同时在具有语法性别的语言中也存在公平性差异。这表明通用基准不足以满足HR领域的需求，需要定制化的评估来识别在语义准确性与公平性之间取得平衡的帕累托最优模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于分类学驱动、完全合成的多语言HR数据集与基准，可同时评估检索有效性与算法公平性，揭示了通用基准在招聘场景中的不足，并为识别兼顾语义准确性与公平性的帕累托最优模型提供了定制化评估方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a taxonomy-driven, fully synthetic multilingual HR dataset and benchmark for simultaneously evaluating retrieval effectiveness and algorithmic fairness, demonstrating that general benchmarks are insufficient for hiring and enabling the identification of Pareto-optimal models that balance semantic accuracy and fairness.
